spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the developer pain the change fixes: a module that fails on an unreliable network becomes recoverable via retry.

interactive.rationale: Service worker plays the flaky network; load/retry/auto-retry drive real import() calls; counters show page imports vs network attempts.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature-index blurb matches what the page delivers.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers cached-failure (retry never reaches network), successful recovery on 156, and honest SW-unavailable fallback.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5214647044145152 and the whatwg PR.

conformance.rationale: Feature conformance.json asserts the exact module-map contracts (refetch on failure, parse-failure stays cached, success stays cached).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless autorun with a dedicated profile: SW installs, controlling reload survives, load then retry drive real imports; on 141 the retry is answered from cache (network saw 1 attempt) and the page labels it as pre-156 behaviour; console clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert called on primary and fallback branches.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; button bg+color set together; WCAG AA.

accessibility.rationale: Native controls, <output aria-live>, table caption/scope, visible focus.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360 or 1280; tap targets >=44px; verified both classes.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the recovery success path on a real Chrome 156 build
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium 141 only the cached-failure branch is observable; when a 156 build is available, confirm the retry reaches the SW on attempt #2 and mounts the widget.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce async action result to screen readers live region status message
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-live/role=status regions and semantic landmarks; every control needs an accessible name; prefer native elements.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Primary readouts use <output aria-live="polite"> and role=status; controls are native <button>/<select> with visible text labels; results tables use <caption> and <th scope>.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless accessibility check: buttons expose text names; live region updates announced on each run.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel and data table on narrow mobile viewport without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap wide tables in an overflow-x:auto container, use scrollbar-gutter:stable and grid auto-fit; keep body free of horizontal overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Tables sit in .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto}; control grids use repeat(auto-fit,minmax(...)); measured documentElement.scrollWidth==innerWidth at 360 and 1280.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP measurement: overflow=0px at 360x740 (DPR3) and 1280x800 for every concept page.

summary: The SW-as-network design makes the module-map behaviour observable on any connection. On 141 it honestly shows the pre-156 unrecoverable state; the recovery branch is coded and asserted, pending a 156 build to see it pass.
